Generated LOCMAF publisher integration fixtures (run from repository root):

ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=32x32:rate=4 -t 1 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -g 2 -bf 0 -movflags +frag_keyframe+empty_moov+default_base_moof+separate_moof -f mp4 tests/fixtures/locmaf-publisher.mp4

ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=48000 -t 1 -c:a aac -b:a 32k -movflags empty_moov+default_base_moof+frag_keyframe -frag_duration 500000 tests/fixtures/locmaf-audio.mp4

ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -i tests/fixtures/locmaf-publisher.mp4 -c copy -movflags +faststart tests/fixtures/locmaf-progressive.mp4

LOC B-frame fixtures (FFmpeg libx264, 64x64, 4 frames, no edit list):
ffmpeg -v error -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=64x64:rate=4 -t 1 -c:v libx264 -g 4 -bf 2 -an -use_editlist 0 -movflags +frag_keyframe+empty_moov+default_base_moof tests/fixtures/loc-bframes-fragmented.mp4
ffmpeg -v error -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=64x64:rate=4 -t 1 -c:v libx264 -g 4 -bf 2 -an -use_editlist 0 tests/fixtures/loc-bframes-progressive.mp4
ffprobe -v error -show_packets -show_entries packet=pts,dts,duration,size,pos,flags -of csv=p=0 tests/fixtures/loc-bframes-fragmented.mp4

Irregular first video sample fixture (FFmpeg libx264 zerolatency video with AAC audio, 64x64 at 30 fps, 0.4 s). With the audio track, FFmpeg writes the first video sample duration as 840 and the rest as 512 at timescale 15360, so a frame rate taken from the first sample alone is 18.286 instead of 30:
ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=64x64:rate=30 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=48000 -t 0.4 -c:v libx264 -tune zerolatency -g 30 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 32k -movflags empty_moov+default_base_moof+separate_moof+frag_keyframe -frag_duration 33333 -f mp4 tests/fixtures/irregular-first-sample.mp4
